item.content:encoded:
Started off relatively amusing, calling out the narrative quirks and handwaving that goes into SCP writing.

It loses a lot of momentum in the various -4 entries, where it begins to lean less on the meta and seems to be content simply falling into the tropes its satirizing. It starts simply spewing out bs without retaining the tounge in cheek tone it sets out with.

And by the end this is absent entirely, with it resolving to lambast an edgy and OP superweapon.

The D-Class portion got a chuckle out of me, but overall it's too dull for me to want to upvote. -1

Hey guys, here's some context for some of the jokes that may have not translated so well

+ show block
– hide block

Dr T█m Long: Original word is "龙█天博士"(Dr A█tian Long), pointed to a fictional character "龙傲天"(Aotian Long The heavenly proud Dragon), a stereo type of perfect characters in Chinese novel like Tom/Mary Sue. Due to the characteristic of this type of characters, here I use the combination of "Tom" Sue and Aotian "Long" to be the name of this guy.
Foundation Agent ██, asked not to be identified his name: That's what the "name" come from, a Interview that tag the interviewed person with "Mr Maru Tong, asked not to be identified his name"
████████ School's Parallel Worlds Traveler Suit: Word that blackboxed is "Infinite". "Infinite School"(無限流) is a genre of Chinese web novel that traveling and adventuring in several dimensions (these dimensions are usually pirated from other novels, games, and comics), usually have a public or private space to be the stronghold of main characters.
